description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is hiring a Director of User Experience Research to lead our research team, drive a user-centered understanding of Players (the people who use Discord), and turn that understanding into a better product. You'll own the research strategy for Discord, build and lead a team of researchers, and make sure a deep, evidence-based understanding of user needs shapes what we build before decisions are made.

You'll uncover and forecast the problems our users face and the opportunities that will add the most value to Discord. You'll deepen our understanding of every user cohort, from longtime gamers to new communities, creators, moderators, and teens. And you'll make sure what we ship results in user value for them. As Discord brings more AI-powered experiences to users, you'll ensure they're grounded in real needs and held to a clear, user-centered quality bar. You'll also modernize how research gets done, using AI to increase our speed and reach without losing rigor.

You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Safety. This person will report to the VP of Product Design and Insights.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the research vision and make research a strategic partner. Own the research roadmap across Discord, balancing foundational, generative, and evaluative work and prioritizing by user impact, business impact, and risk. Deliver clear, compelling readouts that shape prioritization and go/no-go calls, and measure research's impact on product outcomes.
  • Uncover opportunities and build a shared understanding of our users. Lead foundational and generative research that surfaces unmet needs, pain points, and emerging behaviors, and use segmentation, longitudinal, and international research to understand how different user cohorts use Discord and where their needs differ, so teams design for real people instead of assumptions.
  • Own usability and concept validation. Establish a consistent program for testing concepts, prototypes, and live experiences, so teams learn early whether ideas are desirable, usable, and valuable before investing heavily.
  • Bring a mixed-methods lens to every major decision. Partner with Data Science to combine qualitative insight with quantitative evidence (surveys, behavioral data, experimentation) that explains both what users do and why. Define and track experience-health measures such as satisfaction, ease, and trust over time.
  • Define user-centered quality for AI-powered experiences. Work with Product, Engineering, and ML partners to set quality dimensions, rubrics, and human evaluation programs that complement automated and model-based evaluation, so AI features solve real Player problems and earn user trust.
  • Build and scale the practice. Hire and develop researchers and research leads, and create the career paths, rituals, and research operations they need. Equip PMs and designers to run lightweight research with the right guardrails.
  • Modernize research with care and integrity. Adopt and govern AI-assisted tools for recruiting, moderation, synthesis, and insight management that help the team move faster and reach more users. Set the standard for ethical research, including rigor, bias, privacy, consent, and research with teens and vulnerable communities, in partnership with Legal, Privacy, and Safety.

What you should have

  • 12+ years of experience in UX research or a closely related field (such as HCI, Psychology, or Cognitive Science), including 6+ years leading researchers and research leads
  • Deep expertise across generative and evaluative methods, both qualitative and quantitative, with the judgment to turn ambiguous questions into a clear set of risks and design right-sized research for fast-moving product contexts
  • A track record of research that uncovered new opportunities and changed product direction, not only validated existing plans, including usability and concept-testing programs that teams relied on
  • Experience understanding and segmenting diverse user populations, ideally in consumer social, community, communication, or multi-sided platforms
  • Experience researching AI or LLM-powered products, including human evaluation, rubric design, and inter-rater reliability, with a clear view of where automated evaluation helps and where it falls short
  • Fluency with AI-enabled research and data tools, and sound judgment about when they strengthen research and when they weaken it
  • A history of earning buy-in from executives and cross-functional partners by telling the user story and making the "so what" impossible to ignore

Bonus Points

  • Experience in gaming, creator, or real-time communication products
  • Experience conducting research with teens or in trust and safety contexts
  • Global or multi-market research experience
  • Background in survey science, experimentation, or behavioral data analysis

The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Base Salary
$320,000—$400,000 USD

Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.
